title: Security audit and hardening plan: VMs, repos, UI
note: VMs: SSH exposure, open ports, OS patching, fail2ban, key rotation, least-privilege service users, secrets on disk. Repos: public-repo exposure, Actions permissions, branch protection, secret scanning, token scopes. UI and API: CORS, unauthenticated read routes, diag token. Output is a ranked findings list in which each finding becomes a row; fixes follow the tiers. Candidate for a Fable lane (operator 2026-11-11 ~08:15Z, queued for after the 17:59Z reset)
